tasks.desc: Almacén para `.konsora/tasks.json` según §5: lock O_EXCL con {pid, host, at}, que solo se considera caducado si el PID está muerto en el mismo host, con 5 s de espera; leer → validar → aplicar la operación → validar → escritura canónica en temporal + fsync + rename + fsync del directorio. POST /api/projects/:id/ops: ops parsed with the new core OpSchema (zod, strict) and applied through the store as human (the daemon is the human's channel); errors keep the full core error with fitting statuses (403 forbidden, 404, 409 conflict/transition/blocked with the current task on conflict, 422 missing feedback/summary or invalid result, 503 lock timeout). Checks run on every board read and before each UI op (so an external change cannot hide behind the daemon's write); flags persist until confirm (logged) or revert (new human-only core op restore puts back the version from before the first flagged change; created-as-approved goes back to proposed; deleted comes back), and clear themselves if the task leaves the flagged state or is set back by hand.
